question.title: Compare the two reports about A versus B under setting X.
question.description: Retain source A outperformed, source B underperformed, setting X and the unresolved conflict. Compact attribution is allowed; omit unrelated background. Do not adjudicate a winner or assert agreement. Use synthetic sources only; no external knowledge.
